name: Fujiwara Mitsue
source:
The mother of the main character. Her husband died early in life, and she has raised the protagonist by herself. 

She is an ideal mother, beautiful, calm, and patient enough to be envied by the protagonist's classmates.

[From [url=http://msdata.starfree.jp/msg0009/top.html]official site[/url]]
